activeQuestion.promptZh: 為什麼懷疑是授權席次不足？

options.text: All seats are in use, and two classroom computers may still be using seats from yesterday.
options.zh: 所有授權都在使用中，兩台教室電腦可能還占用著昨天的授權。
options.whyZh: 錯誤訊息說浮動授權已全數占用，對話又指出昨天課程的電腦可能仍占用授權。這符合席次不足，不表示軟體安裝有問題。

options.text: The installer says both training computers need a newer driver.
options.zh: 安裝程式說兩部訓練室電腦都需要更新驅動程式。
options.whyZh: 沒有提到驅動程式或安裝檢查。

options.text: The simulation reports an error after opening the trial version.
options.zh: 試用版開啟後，模擬程式回報錯誤。
options.whyZh: 試用版尚未開啟，是稍後才提出的備案。

options.text: The school network rejects the trainer's login after every class.
options.zh: 學校網路在每次下課後都會拒絕講師登入。
options.whyZh: 對話說電腦可能還占用授權，沒有登入錯誤。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 訊息說授權全數在使用；教室電腦可能占著昨天下課後沒釋出的授權。兩個線索都指向沒有空位，而非軟體裝錯。
activeQuestion.evidence: A message says all the floating licenses are in use. Two computers in the training room may still be holding licenses from yesterday's class.

vocabulary.note: 由多台電腦共用的授權席次。

originalQuestion.prompt: Why can the man not start the software?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 男子為什麼無法啟動軟體？

options.whyZh: 對話沒有登入密碼問題。

options.text: The software has not been installed.
options.whyZh: 他已能看到授權不足訊息，問題不在未安裝。

options.text: His model file has been deleted.
options.whyZh: 模型大小只影響試用版適用性，沒有檔案遺失。

options.text: All available licenses are in use.
options.zh: 所有可用授權都被占用了。
options.whyZh: 軟體訊息直接指出 all the floating licenses are in use，沒有顯示帳號或密碼錯誤。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 軟體訊息直接指出 all the floating licenses are in use，沒有顯示帳號或密碼錯誤。

group.title: A floating-license shortage
group.passage:
Man: I can't start the simulation software. A message says all the floating licenses are in use.
Woman: Two computers in the training room may still be holding licenses from yesterday's class.
Man: Should I restart the license server?
Woman: Please don't. That would interrupt active simulations. I'll ask the trainer to close the inactive sessions first.
Man: If that doesn't free a license, can I use the trial version?
Woman: It doesn't support our model size. Let me resolve the license issue, and I'll message you when a seat becomes available.
group.passageZh:
男：我無法啟動模擬軟體。訊息說所有浮動授權都在使用中。
女：訓練教室的兩台電腦可能還占著昨天上課使用的授權。
男：我應該重新啟動授權伺服器嗎？
女：請不要。那會中斷正在執行的模擬。我會先請講師關閉閒置的工作階段。
男：如果這樣還是沒有空出授權，我可以用試用版嗎？
女：試用版不支援我們的模型大小。讓我處理授權問題，有名額可用時就傳訊息給你。
